title: [review] message.rs:269: DaoOriginSignature asymmetric
description: from_bytes accepts origin_sequence=0 and returns Ok, but write_to explicitly rejects origin_sequence=0 with InvalidOption. This allows parsing a signature struct that cannot be re-serialized. SignedDaoEnvelope adds the check at line 354, but the raw API is inconsistent - callers using from_bytes directly may accept invalid zero-sequence signatures.
